I started five agents in parallel. Each works in its own worktree and branch, and none has reported back yet.

| Issue | Lane | Task |
|---|---|---|
| #25 | platform | Define the kip-audio JS API with a web stub |
| #29 | city | Define the city map payload with a fixture |
| #30 | live | Define the live sample and event payloads |
| #31 | stays | Define the Quiet Stays payload with a fixture |
| #41 | night | Show a night's timeline of sleep stages, bedroom noise and wake-ups |

I chose these because they are all ready, each sits in a different lane, and none needs keys or a Mac. That should keep their files from overlapping, because `AGENTS.md` limits each issue to its own feature folders. The board reported 0 overlapping files before I started.

Each agent follows the `hq-work` loop. It claims its issue, builds within scope, runs `./hq check`, rebases and opens its PR. It then does the Entire trail steps and runs `entire review` on anything that isn't `size:S`. #41 also runs `anti-slop`, since it is UI work. None of them will run `./hq ship`, so nothing merges until you say so.

I'll report the PR links when each agent finishes.
